<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/v1/user-stats"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Fetches aggregated stats for a user given a series. The response includes started-puzzle metrics
(counts and streaks) and completed-puzzle metrics (counts, streaks, and solve-time aggregates when available).

**Example:**

```bash
curl -L 'http://localhost:8080/pmm-dev/api/v1/user-stats?series=demo-api&userId=9f7439e7-ecf1-4c03-ba90-91273f149231' \
-H 'Accept: application/json' \
-H 'Authorization: <your_access_token>'
```
